SYM file message order changed after recent update

#### Description

After a recent update, the order of messages when loading SYM files has changed. Messages that were previously loaded in one order are now appearing in reverse order, which breaks compatibility with existing code that depends on message ordering.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# Load a SYM file with multiple message sections
db = cantools.database.load_file('test.sym')

# The message order is now different than expected
for i, message in enumerate(db.messages):
    print(f"Message {i}: {message.name}")
```

When loading SYM files that contain both `{SEND}` and `{RECEIVE}` sections, the messages now appear in a different order than before. Previously, `{SEND}` messages would appear first, followed by `{RECEIVE}` messages. Now the order appears to be reversed.

This affects applications that rely on consistent message ordering when processing SYM database files, particularly when converting between different CAN database formats or when the message index/position matters for the application logic.
</issue>
